title: Episode 3 – 2021 Israeli Election Preview
description:
We look at how the campaign is balanced just a week out from the election, as well as one of the most controversial and extreme parties ever to run for the Knesset, the Jewish Power faction.

Remember to stay tuned our social media feeds @NIFAustralia for all the latest news from the election.
